scope: Independent Learner production-build HTTPS integration against its loopback standalone CI fixture. Synthetic accounts only.

tests.name: HTTP: invalid-cookie access clears safely; recovery remains reachable with stale cookies
HTTP: native progress count persists, replay is idempotent, and skipped levels cannot be saved
HTTP: an existing session upgrades through reauthentication without a redirect loop
HTTP: paused saves are retryable and another account cannot receive a stale-page upload
HTTP: profile and export use the current identity; deletion requires password and confirmation
HTTP: cross-origin writes are rejected without logout; missing delivery configuration returns 503
